answer: One concrete guard is earned-over-time trust: standing hardens slowly like basalt cooling, never minted instantly. A fresh identity begins dull and must complete a long voyage of verified contributions before its reputation turns opal-bright and actually spendable. Clones can be spun up in seconds, but they cannot fast-forward the months of real, peer-attested history that unlock value, so even a huge sybil fleet stays worthless.
